menu.subtitle: The dark frontier awaits
menu.help: Choose your hero. Progress saves automatically. Each new session generates a fresh wilderness layout.

status.loaded: Hero loaded — a fresh world awaits

controls.hint: Press I to open inventory. These are the first migrated systems; quests and dungeons will follow.
controls.skills: Skills: Q / right mouse button and key 1
controls.avoid: Dodge the red warning circle before the strike lands.
controls.navigate: Click clear ground to navigate around obstacles, or choose a target from the enemy list.

footer.legacy: The original game is still available separately on GitHub Pages

WARRIOR.name: Warrior
WARRIOR.desc: A resilient fighter building rage in close combat.

PALADIN.name: Paladin
PALADIN.desc: A holy defender wielding faith and divine power.

MAGE.name: Mage
MAGE.desc: An elemental caster who strikes from a safe distance.

ROGUE.name: Rogue
ROGUE.desc: A nimble assassin relying on agility and critical strikes.

NECROMANCER.name: Necromancer
NECROMANCER.desc: Commands death and channels the essence of fallen foes.

WARLOCK.name: Warlock
WARLOCK.desc: A dark channeler wielding curses and soul power.

combat.dodge: Red ground markers show dangerous zones. Click outside to dodge.

cleave.name: Cleave
cleave.desc: A powerful melee attack dealing increased physical damage.

charge.name: Charge
charge.desc: Rush toward an enemy, strike, and briefly stun it.

judgment.name: Judgment
judgment.desc: A focused strike of holy light at a distant target.

consecration.name: Consecration
consecration.desc: Consecrate the ground, healing the hero and damaging nearby enemies.

fireball.name: Fireball
fireball.desc: A fiery strike that burns an enemy for several seconds.

frostNova.name: Frost Nova
frostNova.desc: Damage and slow nearby enemies with a surge of cold.

shadowDash.name: Shadow Dash
shadowDash.desc: Dash to an enemy and land a powerful strike.

poisonBlade.name: Poison Blade
poisonBlade.desc: Strike an enemy and apply damage over time with poison.

boneSpear.name: Bone Spear
boneSpear.desc: Launch a piercing spear of bone toward the target.

raiseSkeleton.name: Raise Skeleton
raiseSkeleton.desc: Summon a temporary ally that attacks nearby enemies.

lifeDrain.name: Life Drain
lifeDrain.desc: Damage a target and heal the hero for part of the damage dealt.

soulBurn.name: Soul Burn
soulBurn.desc: Curse an enemy with lingering soulfire damage.

wraith.name: Wraith
wraith.desc: A ranged foe. Casts a dark bolt and retreats from melee attackers.

skeleton.name: Skeleton Warrior
skeleton.desc: A close-range fighter with a sweeping attack.

wolf.name: Corrupted Wolf
wolf.desc: A fast hunter. Leaps into a marked area and poisons anyone it catches.

crypt_lord.name: Crypt Lord
crypt_lord.desc: An ancient ruler of the tomb. Heavily armored with a sweeping attack.

merchant.name: Merchant Bram
merchant.description: Whatever survives the road, I will buy. Whatever you're missing, I can sell.

blacksmith.name: Blacksmith Odan
blacksmith.description: Steel is only as good as the hand that tempers it.

ashes.title: Ashes at the Gate
ashes.unstarted: Warden Vesna has a task for you.
ashes.intro: Our last patrol vanished beyond the old road. Shadows draw close to camp, and the fires are fading. Slay three corrupted creatures in the wilderness, then return for your reward.
ashes.inProgress: The fire still protects us, but danger waits beyond the stone road. Defeat three enemies and report back.
ashes.readyDialogue: The road breathes again. I saw the shadows scatter. You have earned the watch's reward.
ashes.finishDialogue: You have done more than we dared hope. Emberwatch is always open to you, wanderer.

trade.bagFull: Your backpack is full. Sell an item to free a slot.
trade.noItems: You have no items in your backpack.
trade.temperHint: The blacksmith permanently improves equipped weapons and armor for gold (up to three times). Equip an item from your inventory first.
trade.noForgeable: Equip a weapon or armor in your inventory, then return to the blacksmith.

dungeon.name: Crypt of the Hollow Crown
dungeon.gateHint: A sealed crypt lies beyond the camp. Enter and purge its darkness.
dungeon.guardsHint: Defeat three stronger guardians to awaken the ruler beneath
dungeon.bossHint: Defeat the Crypt Lord and two retainers. Dodge its wide sweeping attacks.
dungeon.clearedHint: The ruler has fallen. Keep your gold, loot and XP; the world resets next session.
